record.name: Echo Sentinel
record.role: A precision-oriented resonant striker, distinct from the defensive Bellwarden.
record.features: Uses Sonorous Needle as a DEX-based lightning attack; Echo Pulse consumes 2 Echoes to guard an ally or self. Two starting specializations shape the recruit. MP23: Echo Hand manipulates eligible mechanisms and wards at short range under line-of-sight.

styleDefinitions.name: Sonorous Needle
styleDefinitions.description: A resonant DEX-based melee strike dealing lightning damage, ignoring 1 Defense; grows from 1d6 to 1d8 at the veteran milestone.

creationChoices.name: Watcher
creationChoices.description: Favours careful defence with +1 CON and a shield at creation.

creationChoices.name: Runner
creationChoices.description: Favours speed with +1 DEX and a quarterstaff at creation.
